| # Object 0x1002 manufacturer status register {#object-0x1002-manufacturer-status-register-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                                                        |                                                                                                                                                                      |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object is a common status register for manufacturer specific purposes.

 

  Index           0x1002
  --------------- ------------------------------
  Name            Manufacturer Status Register
  Object          VAR
  Data Type       UNSIGNED 32
  Category        Mandatory
  Access          RO
  PDO Mapping     Optional
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0x00000000

 

in rc40 canopen lib, Structure of this status register can be defined as below

 

  --------- ----------------- ------- ---------- ------------
  Bit No    31-28             27      26-8       7-0
  Details   Instance status   Error   reserved   NMT status
  --------- ----------------- ------- ---------- ------------

 

Instance status :  Status of canopen stack instance

             0 : CANopen instance not initialised

             1 : CANopen instance initialised

             2 : CANopen boot message sent

Error : Status of error in canopen instance

            0 : No Error

            1 : Error present

NMT Status : canopen NMT state

            0 : Bootup

            4 : Stopped

            5 : Operational

           127: Pre-Operational
